credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of Georgia O'Keeffe with  back to the camera dressed in a white headscarf, long sleeve jacket and matching skirt and PF Flyer sneakers looking back at the rock face. This photograph is from the Glen Canyon Album that Todd Webb gave to Georgia O'Keeffe 'in memory of the great August 1961 trip down the Colorado River.'
title: Georgia O'Keeffe Looking Back
